sample_values: Multi-LLM benchmark construction for noise complaint intensity, with direct scoring replaced by comparison tasks; a fine-tuned RoBERTa model was then transferred to new datasets. Green exposure was measured by integrating Sentinel-2 NDVI and 3D Green View Index from street-view images, followed by Generalized Additive Models analysis.

LLM-UTP, a scalable and generic city-wide traffic prediction framework with three modules: a trend enhancement module using wavelet denoising and 2D CNN/channel attention to fuse raw and denoised traffic data; a spatiotemporal feature encoding module using dilated convolutions, GRUs, residual connections, RMS normalization, and FFNs to create explicit spatiotemporal tokens; and an LLM module based on GPT-2 with multi-head self-attention and FFN layers. Training uses a three-stage strategy: joint multi-mode training, specific-mode fine-tuning with partial freezing of LLM attention parameters, and testing.

DG-LLM framework combining Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), spatiotemporal embedding, mode-dependent dynamic graph learning via GAT-style attention, a graph-aware pretrained GPT-2 backbone, LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and multi-mode fusion with residual forecasting.

Multimodal large language model (MLLM) framework for urban spatial perception diagnosis; dual-modal input of park images and structured prompts; cross-modal reasoning to map visual features to perceptual indicators; 1-to-10 scoring output; role-based persona simulation for four stakeholder groups; comparison of multiple MLLMs including Gemini-2.5-pro, Gemini-2.5-flash, GPT-4o, Doubao-Seed-1.6-thinking, QvQ-Max, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet; temperature set to 0.2 for evaluation

LLM-driven universal knowledge graph construction using ChatGLM with designed rules and prompts; knowledge graph converted to matrix form; Knowledge Graph Fusion Module (KGFusion) with graph convolution, semantic mapping, and graph reasoning integrated into DDRNet-based semantic segmentation network; GloVe 6B word embeddings used for class vectors

Transformer architecture-based generative AI and semantic text analysis were used to create composite smart city definitions; cosine similarity was used to compare candidate definitions against the collected definitions.
Narrative survey/review of literature on LLMs and other technologies in sustainable smart cities; no original LLM model or experimental pipeline is proposed.

User-centric survey of GenAI/LLM applications in smart cities; conversational interfaces for citizens, operators, and planners; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for grounding responses; integration with urban knowledge graphs, digital twins, and city simulators; human-in-the-loop review in some deployments

TPSC-Sec, an LLM-based multi-agent approach for smart-city security reasoning; specialized agents (Traffic Sentinel, Protocol Analyst, Identity Monitor, Temporal Reasoner, Planner) generate structured hypotheses from role-specific evidence projections; hypotheses are aggregated using Threat-Pheromone Swarm Consensus (TPSC), with an Adaptive Verified TPSC (AV-TPSC) extension that adds verification-aware calibration, context-sensitive weighting, and disagreement-adaptive contradiction control

SORA-ATMAS adaptive trust management framework with a layered SDIoT architecture; dual-chain governance using Agentic Blockchain and SORA Blockchain; multi-LLM evaluation with GPT/ChatGPT, Grok, and DeepSeek; SORA governance layer with security policy, cross-domain operational policy, adaptive trust and risk enforcement, and global repository; MAE-based model selection, error-directed feedback, fallback mechanism, and policy thresholds; domain agents using XGBoost for weather regime classification, YOLOv8 for traffic, and YOLO11 Flare Guard for fire/smoke detection
